stemMd: A concise safety guide says, "Disconnect the battery before opening the case." Which follow-up matches its direct instructional style?

options.label: A
options.textMd: At this juncture, one might perhaps contemplate a cover-removal event.

options.label: B
options.textMd: The cover is a fascinating philosophical boundary.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Hey, just yank that thing off somehow!

options.label: D
options.textMd: Use an insulated tool to remove the cover.

explanationMd: The guide uses clear action verbs and specific objects. The insulated-tool instruction gives the next action with the same directness and precision.

distractorRationale.c: Slang and imprecision conflict with the careful instruction.
distractorRationale.a: Hedging and abstract nouns obscure the instruction.
distractorRationale.b: This digression does not continue the procedural register.
